subject: Post-call: controls scope, retention windows & pen-test evidence (LumenPay)
body_preview: Thanks for the call today — summary of SOC 2 scoping, audit-log retention options, DPA touchpoints, and pen-test evidence we can provide; next steps and owners included.
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@lumenpay.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@lumenpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call: controls scope, retention windows & pen-test evidence (LumenPay)

Hi Marta / Samir —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and confirmation of the items we discussed so we have alignment before I loop in Legal / Infra for DPA and artifact delivery. Please correct anything I missed.

High-level goals you shared
- Support launch of LumenPay Connect (payments orchestration) with a log retention and DPA model acceptable to your enterprise customers.
- Provide evidence for SOC 2 control mapping for data-in-transit, access controls, and logging within 6–8 weeks for a procurement review.
- Minimum retention requirements: 1 year for auth/audit trails, 3 years for transaction metadata for regulatory oversight (you indicated the 3yr requirement might be scoped to a subset).

Key pain points
- Procurement team requires a pen-test report or attestation before sandbox access is granted.
- Ambiguity around which audit logs we can export and in what formats (you need unreadable-logs vs parsed JSON exports).
- DPA clauses around cross-border processing and subprocessor disclosure are a gating item.

What Redwood can commit to / immediate asks
- SOC 2: we can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report summary and a control mapping against your checklist. I attached a pared-down SOC2-questionnaire-lite.xlsx for your technical reviewers to map fields.
- Audit logs: Redwood can stream raw audit-log events and provide daily JSON dumps (configurable retention). Ben (cc'd) will follow up with exact event types and retention configuration we support.
- Pen test: we can provide the most recent pen-test report (redacted) and a vendor attestation; if you need a full re-test on your timeline we can discuss SOWs.
- DPA: attached DPA-draft-annotations.docx with suggested redlines relevant to retention and subprocessor notice windows.

Immediate next steps / owners
1) Ben Carter (Redwood) — share CSV of available audit-log event schema + retention knobs by EOD 5/22. (Ben, confirm if 1-year and 3-year exports can be scoped per topic.)
2) Marta (LumenPay) — confirm whether the 3-year retention applies to all transaction metadata or only settlement records by 5/24.
3) Chloe (Redwood) — circulate SOC2 summary + control mapping after Ben's event schema, then coordinate Legal to share a DPA redline window. Target: initial packet to LumenPay by 5/26.
4) Samir (LumenPay) — confirm procurement deadline for sandbox access / whether pen-test attestation is sufficient.

Attachments: SOC2-questionnaire-lite.xlsx, data_flow_sketch.png, DPA-draft-annotations.docx

If that all looks right I will mark action items and set up a 30-minute tech sync with Ben and your infra team for next week.

Best,

Chloe Martin
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0182

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@lumenpay.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lumenpay.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: controls scope, retention windows & pen-test evidence (LumenPay)

Thanks Chloe — good summary. A few quick clarifications:

- The 3-year requirement applies only to settlement & refund trails (not every transaction event). We'll send a short note that identifies the fields we consider "settlement metadata" by 5/24.
- For the pen-test, procurement will accept a recent 3rd-party pentest report + a signed attestation confirming no critical open findings. If Redwood can provide that along with the SOC2 summary that should be enough for sandbox access.
- Audit logs: we want both a raw event stream (for forensic use) and a parsed JSON export for our analytics pipeline. Can you confirm both are possible?

Action: I'll aim to get the settlement-field list to you by 5/24. Procurement deadline is 6/07 for our pilot cohort.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to join the tech sync with Ben next week.

—Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of IT Security
LumenPay
marta.ruiz@lumenpay.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Audit-log capabilities and retention options (for LumenPay)

Chloe / Laura — forwarding the technical details I promised. Summary below; full CSV attached (auditlog-capabilities.csv).

Summary technical notes
- Event types we can stream: auth_success, auth_failure, token_issued, token_revoked, api_request (headers + route), db_write (redacted PII by policy), billing_event, settlement_event.
- Export formats: newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON), gzipped daily JSON bundle, and raw protobuf event stream for high-throughput ingest.
- Retention controls: per-stream TTL configurable between 30 days — 36 months. We support separate TTL per event topic (so you can keep settlement_event for 36 months and auth_* for 12 months).
- Integrity: we provide SHA256 hashes per daily bundle plus a signed manifest for audit verification.
- Access: S3-compatible export, optional push to your ingest endpoint, or Secure FTP.

Open items (need input from LumenPay)
- Which export format do you prefer for your analytics pipeline (NDJSON vs protobuf)?
- Which settlement fields (you said you would confirm) should be included in the 36-month retention bucket vs the 12-month bucket?

Next steps I can take
- Prepare a sample 7-day NDJSON bundle with anonymized rows for you to validate schema. ETA: 5/25 if we confirm NDJSON.
- Provide the redacted pen-test attestation and SOC2 summary to procurement once legal signs off on the DPA redlines.

Attachments: auditlog-capabilities.csv

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@lumenpay.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 12:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: controls scope, retention windows & pen-test evidence (LumenPay)

Thanks Ben / Chloe — that level of detail helps a lot. Confirming next steps on our side and acceptance criteria: 

- LumenPay will review the CSV and sample NDJSON bundle. If the sample schema maps to our analytics fields we will accept NDJSON.
- We will send the settlement field list by 5/24 (as noted).
- Procurement requires the SOC2 summary + pen-test attestation before 6/07; happy to accept redacted versions as long as hashes/manifests are provided for integrity checks.

Can we tentatively schedule the tech sync for Friday 5/26 at 11am ET? If Ben can share the NDJSON sample by 5/25 that gives us time to review.

I'll loop our Legal if there are outstanding DPA items after you send the redline. Otherwise this is looking good — thanks for the quick follow-through.

—Marta
notes: Thread contains a mix of sales coordination and technical compliance details; internal owners assigned for artifact delivery (Ben) and legal/DPA coordination (Chloe).
